description: This file provides utility functions for mapping statuses and strings to specific color values, primarily for use in UI components related to status visualization. It includes functions for deterministic color generation from strings and for mapping common status labels to themed colors, considering dark background contexts.

methods.name: colorFromString(key, { saturation = 55, lightness = 55 } = {})
methods.description: Generates a deterministic pastel-like HSL color string from an input string, producing distinct hues based on the input.

methods.name: getStatusColor(status, oc)
methods.description: Maps a given status string to a predefined theme color, with fallbacks to a deterministic color if the status is unrecognized.
